recipes.description: Fill the holes in an existing list — phone, LinkedIn, description and website are only enriched where they're empty, so good data is never overwritten.
recipes.name: Backfill missing CRM fields

recipes.description: Turn a raw list into sequence-ready rows: a verified email, two likely pain points, and a personalized opening line for every company.
recipes.name: Cold email personalization at scale

recipes.description: Turn a list of competitors into battlecards: positioning, detected tech stack, headcount, and a researched strengths/weaknesses summary per company.
recipes.name: Competitor battlecards

recipes.description: Refresh stale CRM records: headcount, industry tags, founding year and registered address from public registries and the company's own website.
recipes.name: CRM record refresh (firmographics)

recipes.description: Discover direct-to-consumer e-commerce brands (Shopify stores, review sites), pull a company one-liner, and find a contactable email for each store.
recipes.name: D2C e-commerce brands with contact emails

recipes.description: Derive a canonical domain and a lowercased company key from each row with safe formulas — the join keys you need before deduping or merging lists.
recipes.name: Normalize & dedupe prep (domains + clean names)

recipes.description: Import your list (CSV or leads), verify every email with SMTP + account-presence checks, extract the domain, and re-find addresses for rows that fail.
recipes.name: Email list verification & cleanup

recipes.description: Complete each row (email, phone, LinkedIn, headcount) with zero-key waterfalls, then push finished contacts into HubSpot as CRM records.
recipes.name: Enrich & sync to HubSpot

recipes.description: Find the founder or key decision maker at each company, get a verified email, and draft a personalized opener — ready to enroll in a sequence.
recipes.name: Founder & decision-maker outreach

recipes.description: Track funding stage, last round, investors and recent news across your accounts, and research one cited, recent signal per company.
recipes.name: Funding-round watch

recipes.description: Detect open roles across your accounts from public ATS boards, then turn each hiring signal into a concrete outreach angle — pushed to your webhook.
recipes.name: Hiring-signals radar

recipes.description: Source funded Indian startups from Tracxn, Inc42 and YourStory, add founding year, headcount and a one-liner — a ready-made market map for any segment.
recipes.name: India startup market map

recipes.description: Build a directory of IT services and consulting firms in India from IndiaMART, Justdial and Clutch, with phone, registered address, email, and a lead score.
recipes.name: IT services companies in India (directories)

recipes.description: Source companies actively posting on Naukri, Indeed and Shine — a spend-signal — then find an HR/hiring contact and a verified email.
recipes.name: Job-board intent (India)

recipes.description: For every account on your call list: what they do, one recent concrete signal (news, hiring, funding), and a suggested outreach angle — cited.
recipes.name: Pre-call account briefs

recipes.description: Source SaaS vendors from G2, Capterra and Product Hunt, detect their tech stack and headcount, and score how well each fits your ICP.
recipes.name: SaaS companies from review sites (G2 / Capterra)

recipes.description: Source 100 SaaS companies in India, find the founders, discover and verify their emails, score ICP fit, and push clean contacts to HubSpot.
recipes.name: SaaS founders in India → verified emails → HubSpot

recipes.description: Detect each company's technologies twice — a website fingerprint waterfall plus an evidence-only research agent over job posts — and reconcile them.
recipes.name: Tech-stack mapping

recipes.description: Enrich each row with a verified email and firmographics, then POST the finished row to any endpoint you own — Zapier, n8n, your own API.
recipes.name: Enrich & push via webhook
